title: Tensor localization of a localized pushout square
statement: Let R,A,S,C,L_A,L_C be commutative rings, with maps σ:R→A, ρ:R→S, a:A→C, b:S→C making C the pushout of σ and ρ (the colimit of their span [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]). Let l_A:A→L_A and l_C:C→L_C be localizations at multiplicative submonoids M⊆A and N⊆C, respectively, in the sense of [lem-weil-pbc-localization-of-localization]. Assume a(M)⊆N and let m:L_A→L_C satisfy m l_A=l_C a. Give L_A its R-algebra structure l_A σ and S its R-algebra structure ρ. Then there is a ring map φ:L_A tensor_R S→L_C, φ(x tensor y)=m(x) l_C(b(y)), and a multiplicative submonoid U of L_A tensor_R S such that φ exhibits L_C as its localization at U. The tensor product is the module tensor [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], with multiplication (x tensor y)(x' tensor y')=(xx') tensor (yy') and unit 1 tensor 1.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00QV, verification of assertion (4) for the polynomial-quotient pushout; expanded from localization base change and nested localization.

proof.text: Put M′=a(M), L=(M′)⁻¹C. The map A→C induces t:L_A→L with t l_A=loc_C a. Localization base change gives a pushout square A→C, L_A→L. In Lean this is CommRingCat.isPushout_of_isLocalization applied to IsLocalization.map.

Paste this square horizontally with the given pushout R,A,S,C. Thus L is the pushout of R→L_A and R→S. Compare it with the canonical tensor-product pushout to obtain e:L_A tensor_R S≃L, whose restrictions are e(x tensor 1)=t(x) and e(1 tensor y)=loc_C(b(y)). Their product gives its formula on every pure tensor.

Since M′⊆N, l_C sends M′ to units and induces v:L→L_C with v loc_C=l_C. Localization uniqueness gives v t=m after precomposition with l_A. Nested localization makes v a localization at loc_C(N). Set φ=v e and transfer this localization across e, using U=e⁻¹(loc_C(N)), written as its image under e.symm. Multiplicativity and the two restrictions above give φ(x tensor y)=m(x) l_C(b(y)).

proof_origin.place: Expanded verification of Tag 00QV (4), using Mathlib pushout and localization universal properties; source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00QV.

lean.statement: theorem exists_localized_pushout_tensor (R A S C LA LC : CommRingCat.{u}) (σ : R →+* A) (ρ : R →+* S) (a : A →+* C) (b : S →+* C) (hp : IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom σ) (CommRingCat.ofHom ρ) (CommRingCat.ofHom a) (CommRingCat.ofHom b)) (lA : A →+* LA) (lC : C →+* LC) (m : LA →+* LC) (hm : m.comp lA = lC.comp a) (M : Submonoid A) (N : Submonoid C) (hMN : M.map a ≤ N) (hLA : letI := lA.toAlgebra; IsLocalization M LA) (hLC : letI := lC.toAlgebra; IsLocalization N LC) : letI := σ.toAlgebra letI := ρ.toAlgebra letI := (lA.comp σ).toAlgebra ∃ φ : LA ⊗[R] S →+* LC, (∀ (x : LA) (y : S), φ (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) = m x * lC (b y)) ∧ (letI := φ.toAlgebra ∃ U : Submonoid (LA ⊗[R] S), IsLocalization U LC)
